title: My game about the AI government drones conspiracy
author: MicesterWayne
selftext:
I got inspired by the conspiracy that the government replaced all the birds with AI robot drones to spy on people.

So I did what any sane person would do 

I made a game where you're a pigeon being the last real one fighting off these hordes. 

Does the lore fit? I think it makes sense because the government can just mass produce the drones (hence the endless waves)

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/MicesterWayne this post needs more detail on how you used AI in development. Saying you used AI isn't the same as explaining how. Rule 4 asks promotional posts to contribute by talking about the process. We're trying to keep "check out my game" posts from taking over the sub. If you don't update, this may be removed.
